properties.description: This pipeline orchestrates the end to end pipeline from source (ideally s3 where client lands data, but here we simulate it with ADLS) to external UC table in silver layer

activities.name: Wait until prev run of cycle is C or F
activities.description:
Here we check previous run status of the cycle (CYC_SK = 101) from Azure sql metadata table. We wait until it completes (C) or Fails (F). The loop exits only when the said condition is satisfied.

This activity takes input from its Lookup activity

Note:
Although we have defined a table while creating the dataset (ds_asql_abc), the "Query" setting in the Lookup activity overrides that predefined table and allows us to query any table within that predefined schema.

activities.name: Get CYC Status
activities.description:
We check the run status (CYC_STS_CD) for this pipeline ((CYC_SK = 101) from CYC_CTRL_TBL table

CYC_SK value is passed from pipeline parameter CYC_SK

activities.name: Wait until prev run of Step and Job is C or F
activities.description:
Checks previous run status for Steps & Jobs of cycle (CYC_SK = 101) from Azure SQL metadata tables. Here we wait until no Steps or Jobs remain "I" (In-progress), meaning all are either C (Complete) or F (Fail). The loop exits only when the said condition is satisfied.

Logic:
Instead of checking "all records = C or F" (complex), we count records with 'I' status. When count = 0, all records have reached terminal status (C or F).

This activity takes input from its Lookup activity

Note:
Although we have defined a table while creating the dataset (ds_asql_abc), the "Query" setting in the Lookup activity overrides that predefined table and allows us to query any table within that predefined schema.

dependsOn.activity: Wait until prev run of cycle is C or F

activities.name: Get STEP Status
activities.description:
We check how many steps are still in‑progress (STEP_STS_CD = 'I') for this pipeline (STEP_SK in [RAW, REPLICA, REFINED]) from STEP_CTRL_TBL table.

STEP_SK values (10110 & 10120 & 10230) are passed from pipeline parameters STEP_SK_RAW, STEP_SK_REPLICA, STEP_SK_REFINED respectively.

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT COUNT(STEP_STS_CD) AS STEP_STS_CD_COUNT FROM @{pipeline().parameters.ASQL_SCHEMA}.STEP_CTRL_TBL WHERE STEP_SK IN ('@{pipeline().parameters.STEP_SK_RAW}','@{pipeline().parameters.STEP_SK_REPLICA}','@{pipeline().parameters.STEP_SK_REFINED}') and STEP_STS_CD='I'

activities.name: Get JOB Status
activities.description:
We check how many jobs are still in‑progress (JOB_STS_CD = 'I') for this pipeline (STEP_SK in [RAW, REPLICA, REFINED]) from JOB_CTRL_TBL table.

STEP_SK values (10110 & 10120 & 10230) are passed from pipeline parameters STEP_SK_RAW, STEP_SK_REPLICA, STEP_SK_REFINED respectively.

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT COUNT(JOB_STS_CD) as JOB_STS_CD_COUNT FROM @{pipeline().parameters.ASQL_SCHEMA}.JOB_CTRL_TBL WHERE STEP_SK IN ('@{pipeline().parameters.STEP_SK_RAW}','@{pipeline().parameters.STEP_SK_REPLICA}','@{pipeline().parameters.STEP_SK_REFINED}') and JOB_STS_CD='I'

activities.name: Check cycle run status
activities.description:
Here we check if the Cycle run has completed (CYC_STS_CD = 'C') from the CYC_CTRL_TBL table using the "Get CYC Status" lookup activity.

It basically runs the 'Get CYC Status' lookup, grabs the first row, checks the column CYC_STS_CD — if its value is 'C', returns true; otherwise returns false."

dependsOn.activity: Wait until prev run of Step and Job is C or F

ifTrueActivities.name: Cycle Start
ifTrueActivities.description:
This stored procedure prepares cycle tracking tables:

1. Adds new row to CYC_RUN_TBL (with CYC_STS_CD = 'I' & CYC_RUN_SK for the newly created row)
2. Updates CYC_CTRL_TBL (sets cycle status CYC_STS_CD ='I' & updates CYC_CUR_RUN_SK with the value of CYC_RUN_SK from above point)
3. Resets STEP_CTRL_TBL (all steps back to STEP_STS_CD = 'C') — only if FORCE_IND='N' ###Need to check this part as downstream activities should already have made this C due to which Cycle status becomes C

Parameters:
CYC_SK = Identifies which cycle to start (e.g., 101)
FORCE_IND = Controls step reset behaviour — 'N' (default) resets all steps for a fresh run; 'Y' preserves already-completed steps to allow mid-run restart without re-running finished steps
PL_RUN_ID = Current ADF pipeline run ID (auto-generated unique GUID) for complete audit trail. Auto-populated by ADF

ifTrueActivities.name: Copy Manifest File from Source to ADLS
ifTrueActivities.description: We copy the manifest.json file from client storage account to our storage account

typeProperties.notebookPath: /insurance_claims_domain/01 Copy Manifest File from Source to ADLS

ifTrueActivities.name: Load Manifest Data to Azure SQL
ifTrueActivities.description:
The notebook:
- Reads manifest.json from ADLS
- Parses each table entry in it
- Writes those rows into abc.MANIFEST
- Then calls the stored proc to update abc.TABLE_LOAD_METADATA

dependsOn.activity: Copy Manifest File from Source to ADLS

typeProperties.notebookPath: /insurance_claims_domain/02 Load Manifest Data to Azure SQL

ifTrueActivities.name: Detect and List Files to Load
ifTrueActivities.description:
The notebook:
- Reads TABLE_LOAD_METADATA, CDA_FILE_LOADS, and MANIFEST from Azure SQL
- Compares latest timestamps to determine full load (first run) or incremental load (subsequent runs)
- Lists parquet file paths from ADLS that have not yet been loaded
- Stages the file list in a global temp view TEMP_FILE_INFO_TABLE for notebook 04 to consume
- No actual data is read or loaded at this stage — this notebook works purely at the file path level; parquet contents are not touched

dependsOn.activity: Load Manifest Data to Azure SQL

typeProperties.notebookPath: /insurance_claims_domain/03 Detect and List Files to Load

ifTrueActivities.name: Populate CDA_FILE_LOADS Table
ifTrueActivities.description:
Registers every new parquet file that needs to be loaded into the pipeline.

Notebook 03 found which files exist in ADLS. This notebook takes that list and saves it into CDA_FILE_LOADS in Azure SQL — one row per file — marking each as "not yet loaded" (IS_LOADED=0). The Src→Raw notebook will later read this table to know exactly which files to copy into the raw zone.

The notebook:
- Reads TABLE_LOAD_METADATA and CDA_FILE_LOADS from Azure SQL into temp views
- Reads the file list from global_temp.TEMP_FILE_INFO_TABLE staged by notebook 03
- Joins the three — only keeping files where LOAD_STATUS = 'I' (new data detected) and not already present in CDA_FILE_LOADS
- Inserts the resulting rows into abc.CDA_FILE_LOADS with IS_LOADED=0, tagged with CYC_RUN_SK

dependsOn.activity: Detect and List Files to Load

activities.name: Fetch CYC_CUR_RUN_SK
activities.description: Fetches the current cycle run Surrogate Key (CYC_CUR_RUN_SK) for the specified cycle from CYC_CTRL_TBL and passes downstream to child pipelines.

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT CAST(CYC_CUR_RUN_SK AS VARCHAR) AS CYC_CUR_RUN_SK FROM @{pipeline().parameters.ASQL_SCHEMA}.CYC_CTRL_TBL WHERE CYC_SK=@{pipeline().parameters.CYC_SK}

activities.name: Manifest Failure Email
activities.description:
Sends pipeline failure details to Logic App, which then emails the recipient about cycle status check failure before manifest processing.

Global parameters work at the factory level, shared across ALL pipelines - not defined per pipeline.

Perfect for failure emails because: Single update point (change LogicAppURL once, updates everywhere), ensures consistent alerting to the same ops team automatically.

For this project: Same team monitors all pipelines, so one global config = one place to maintain alerting infrastructure.

body.value:
{ "message" : "Hi Team,

Step Name:@{pipeline().Pipeline}

Run ID:@{pipeline().RunId}

Status: Failed

Message: Failure in Manifest Flattening process

", "dataFactoryName" : "@{pipeline().DataFactory}", "pipelineName" : "@{pipeline().Pipeline}" }

activities.name: Source To Raw Data Load
activities.description: The pipeline called by this activity copies the data (parquet files) from Client owned data store to our ADLS container

activities.name: Raw To Replica
activities.description: The pipeline called by this activity copies the data (parquet files) from our ADLS container to External Unity Catalog Tables

activities.name: To Truncate Data In archive Tables
activities.description: Loops over each backup table name and takes a fresh snapshot — truncates the old backup then copies the current data into it.

activities.name: Copy Data To Archive
activities.description: Truncates the target _BACKUP table then bulk-inserts all XCENTER='CC' rows from the source table — one table per iteration.

activities.name: Archival of CDA FILE LOADS
activities.description: Moves CDA_FILE_LOADS rows older than 30 days (already loaded, IS_LOADED=1) into CDA_FILE_LOADS_ARCHIVE, then deletes them from the source table — keeping CDA_FILE_LOADS lean while preserving history.

dependsOn.activity: To Truncate Data In archive Tables
